## Summary

Fixes the post-merge ADR 0122 validation regression without changing spatial-audio runtime or serialization contracts. The legacy three-argument Inspector helper is test-only, a visual-validation-only listener capture target checks the real Audio Listener Inspector, and the listener guidance text explicitly wraps instead of inheriting dock-wide truncation.

## Validation

Fresh Windows affected validation is required on the final head. Visual validation verifies the Spatial Audio overview/gizmos, scrolled emitter attenuation/audition controls, and the Audio Listener Inspector with readable guidance on that final head.
